intro.title: How do you work as a founder?
paragraphs: Take your time with the next questions. Answer as you usually would in everyday work, rather than how you think you ideally should.
The first is about you: how you approach decisions, deal with uncertainty, and raise different views.
Then we will look at your specific venture and how you work together.
There are no right or wrong answers. If you cannot assess something yet, you can simply say so.

screens.title: Experience and intuition
screens.transition: Not every decision can be worked out completely.
screens.subline: How much room do you give your experience and intuition?

screens.title: Trying things out and learning
screens.transition: What do you do when you do not have all the information yet?

screens.title: Making concerns visible
screens.transition: Not every disagreement needs a full discussion straight away. We are interested in when you make it visible.

screens.title: Expressing disagreement
screens.transition: When you disagree, how do you put it into words?

screens.title: When things are still unclear I
screens.transition: Finally, a few situations where things are still unclear.
screens.groupPrompt: How comfortable do you feel with each situation?

screens.title: When things are still unclear II
screens.groupPrompt: How comfortable do you feel with each situation?

closing.title: All done.
closing.text: Take another look at your responses. When everything reflects your situation, you can finish this part.
